decision: Changes required; do not integrate this modal implementation as cleared.

findings.title: Reduced-color backdrop does not force the frozen muted foreground
findings.evidence: Frozen src/theme.rs 1301-1310 returns muted (primary only if muted equals background) plus DIM for every nonblank Ansi16/Mono cell. Candidate only adds DIM to the preexisting faint/ghost foreground. Independent real Harness paints an accent x on black with distinct custom faint and muted tokens: actual cyan Rgb(0,255,255), expected muted Rgb(150,150,150). Pure public API reproduces the same failure. This is visible modal-underlay output, not merely an internal style difference.
findings.repair: Evaluate the frozen nonblank reduced-color rule in the shared mapper before constructing the final style; choose muted or primary as specified. Preserve the existing backdrop_colors pair API output.

findings.title: Collision fallback erases the DIM decision before backdrop_style checks it
findings.evidence: map_backdrop replaces a nonblank mapped foreground equal to the mapped background at lines298-300. backdrop_style then tests the replacement foreground for equality, so TrueColor/Ansi256 cannot observe the original collision. Independent TrueColor probe uses ghost==canvas and a low-contrast arbitrary foreground: correct muted ink but modifier NONE instead of frozen DIM. Native new test forces a different muted/background collision and does not cover this branch.
findings.repair: Keep the raw mapped foreground/collision information through style resolution. Apply the frozen collision/reduced-color branch before fallback, returning muted-or-primary plus DIM. Retain backdrop_colors legacy collision fallback separately without changing that public pair result.

checks.result: 4 tests run:1 passed,3 failed,0 skipped; pure reduced ink, pure collision DIM, and actual Harness reduced ink all fail. Existing pair API compiles and passes.

compatibility.public_pair_api: Existing signature remains usable and compiles in the external consumer. Source comparison of the old pair implementation with Some(fg)/Some(bg) in the new private mapper shows equivalent foreground/background mapping for concrete colors; no before/after exhaustive execution claimed.
compatibility.new_api: Theme::backdrop_style is additive. Style import does not remove existing exports.
compatibility.ownership: Pure Theme mapping and shared runtime delegation are appropriate; per-paint environment reads and hardcoded RGB branches are removed. No unsafe or concurrency changes found.

coverage_gaps: Do not claim the requested complete NO_COLOR absent/empty/present and force/explicit-theme subprocess matrix; not independently run because required mapping regressions already block acceptance.
Clipping, custom ASCII focus glyph, zero-size and full modifier combinations were source-inspected but not comprehensively independently executed.
The runtime clears non-ASCII focus glyph independent of foreground and replaces modifiers as the frozen ctx implementation specifies.

Existing Showcase DialogsPage uses real Dialog update/draw and runtime composite_layer invokes modal_backdrop for drawn dim layers; this demonstrates the behavior path. No catalog registration or explicit coverage allowance for the new public Theme::backdrop_style was found; the author audit correctly records this remaining follow-up.
No full workspace gates, four-application parity, hosted CI or reference approval claimed.
Known all73 theme failure is not waived or reapproved by this review.
